# WeProvideLeads

> WeProvideLeads gets contractors and service businesses more local customer inquiries. We build websites for one trade in one town (for example, mold removal in Guelph), work to get them to the top of Google search and Google Maps, and send every call and form inquiry from that website to one business. A contractor can rent a website's leads for a flat monthly fee, or pay once to own a lead website built for their trade and area. Based in Guelph, Ontario, Canada; we build for contractors anywhere.

## Two ways to work with us

1. **Exclusive leads (rent a website).** We own and run the website. Its calls and form inquiries go to one business only, never shared with other contractors. The first 5 leads are free. After that it is a flat monthly fee **from $200 a month (CAD, plus HST)**, depending on the trade and area. No setup fee, no per-lead charge, no percentage of the job, no long-term contract; cancel any time (the current month is not refunded). Exclusivity covers the website rented.
2. **Own your website.** We build a lead-generation website for the contractor's trade and service area, then transfer ownership to them. Price per website: **1 website $1,500; 3 websites $1,250 each ($3,750); 5 websites $1,000 each ($5,000)**, CAD plus HST. One website covers one trade in one city or area. After handover the owner pays their own domain renewal, hosting and phone service directly to those providers. Maintenance and support after handover are an optional paid extra. No free trial on this option.

## How the leads are generated

- Each website targets one trade in one town, which Google rewards with relevance.
- Each has pages for every service and nearby area, and we work to get it into Google Maps results.
- Traffic is regular (unpaid) Google results, not ads. The contractor runs no ads and builds no website.
- Calls ring straight to the contractor's phone with a short message saying it is a lead from us; form requests arrive by email with the customer's name, number and what they need.

## Trades

Any trade customers search for. Current and past websites cover: general contracting, home, basement, kitchen and bathroom renovation, custom homes, drywall, painting, insulation, decks, concrete, epoxy flooring, roofing, eavestroughs, siding, windows, fencing, interlocking, excavation, hydrovac, tree service, lawn care, snow removal, Christmas light installation, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, furnaces, air conditioning, gas fitting, fire alarms, garage doors, appliance repair, locksmith, metal fabrication, auto repair, mold removal, basement waterproofing, water damage, foundation repair, pest control, commercial and house cleaning, carpet and window cleaning, power washing, duct cleaning, junk removal and dumpster rental. We also build for movers, chauffeurs, insurance and real estate.

## Where

The current network is centred on Guelph, Kitchener, Waterloo and Cambridge, Ontario. New websites can be built for any town in Canada or elsewhere.

## What we don't promise

Rankings and inquiry volume vary by website, trade, area and season. We don't guarantee rankings, jobs or a set number of leads. Before a contractor starts, we show them the website for their trade and what it currently ranks for.
